g.text: Left: unique source answers; includes assistant_end and supervised tool-call delimiters, excludes tool outputs. At most 0.26% of any curve lies beyond 1,000.

g.text: Short = fits 4 cycles (4,093 rendered tokens). Delayed = one answer with no supervision in the first 4 cycles. Needs 12/24 = smallest fitting episode size.

g.text: Right: 498 complete updates, mix 4x8:29,12x2:2,24x1:2; SmolTalk/MMLU/GSM8K repeated 1/3/4×. Includes 3,449/2,965 EOM targets. Shares are counts, not loss weights.
